item.text: I’ll emit the complete Stage 1 topology and decisions only, using the analyzed story map and the supplied suite boundary.

=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Define application modules and ownership boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md, cli.md
provides:     application module boundaries
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Define the module boundaries and ownership rules for the CLI, API, configuration, and persistence library. Keep database-driver access inside the shipped persistence library.

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates schema and repository contract.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md, persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:     rates repository operations
depends:      architecture
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table and the repository operations needed by loading and API stories. Store published rate values as text, keyed by date and currency.

## story cli_init
summary:      Initialize an empty rates store.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Init.md
covers:       CLI-001
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates init
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement `fxrates init` to create an empty rates table and print nothing, using the declared persistence interface.

## story cli_load
summary:      Validate, load, and report ECB history files.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Load.md
covers:       CLI-002, CLI-003
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, sqlite.md
provides:     fxrates load
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-003, st-008
context:      sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement whole-file validation before any write, skip N/A values, replace existing date and currency keys, and report dates and rates stored. A rejected file exits 3 and changes nothing.

## story cli_errors
summary:      Report CLI usage and operational errors.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:       CLI-004
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:     CLI usage and operational error responses
consumes:     fxrates init, fxrates load, fxrates fetch, fxrates serve
depends:      cli_init, cli_load, cli_fetch, cli_serve
accepts:       st-007
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement conventional CLI usage and operational error handling: usage failures exit 2, unreadable files and fetch failures exit 1, with no stdout and one diagnostic line on stderr.

## story cli_fetch
summary:      Fetch and load the ECB history archive.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Fetch.md
covers:       CLI-005
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:     fxrates fetch
consumes:     fxrates load
depends:      cli_load
accepts:       st-009
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Download the ECB history ZIP, extract eurofxref-hist.csv, and load it with the same validation and reporting behavior as the load command. Keep tests offline by stubbing the download.

## story api_health_stats
summary:      Serve health and database statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Health-Stats.md
covers:       API-001
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /health, GET /stats
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-004, st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement JSON health and statistics routes, including null first and last dates for an empty store.

## story api_currencies
summary:      List currencies with stored rates.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Currencies.md
covers:       API-002
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /currencies
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement the currency listing route with EUR as base and stored currencies in ascending order.

## story api_rates
summary:      Resolve rates by effective publication date.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Rates.md
covers:       API-003
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /rates/latest
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-005, st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement date and latest rate routes. Resolve a requested date to the latest publication on or before it, and return 404 when no publication exists.

## story api_convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies using exact decimals.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Convert.md
covers:       API-004
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /convert
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-005, st-006, st-007, st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement conversion with exact Decimal arithmetic, half-even rounding, six decimal places for the rate, and two for the result. Resolve effective dates and return the specified validation and not-found statuses.

## story api_history
summary:      Return currency history and summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-History.md
covers:       API-005
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:     GET /history/{code}
consumes:     rates repository operations
depends:      database
accepts:       st-006, st-007, st-008
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement ascending currency history with inclusive optional bounds, stored text rates, exact Decimal mean rounded half-even to six places, and null statistics for empty ranges.

## story api_validation
summary:      Validate API request parameters and currency availability.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-API-Validation.md
covers:       API-006
stack:        common.md, python.md, fastapi.md
provides:     API request validation behavior
consumes:     GET /rates/{date}, GET /convert, GET /history/{code}
depends:      api_rates, api_convert, api_history
accepts:       st-007
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Ensure malformed dates and amounts and missing required query parameters return 422; unknown currencies and unavailable rates return 404.

## story cli_serve
summary:      Run the API server on the requested local port.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CLI-Serve.md
covers:       RUN-001
stack:        common.md, python.md, cli.md, fastapi.md
provides:     fxrates serve
consumes:     FastAPI application
depends:      api_health_stats
accepts:       st-004
acceptance:   yes
instructions: |
  Implement foreground serving on 127.0.0.1 at the requested port, defaulting to 8000, and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.

## story verification
summary:      Run the supplied full conformance harness.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       RUN-002
stack:        common.md, python.md
depends:      cli_init, cli_load, cli_errors, cli_fetch, api_health_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_convert, api_history, api_validation, cli_serve
acceptance:   yes
context:      sources/run.sh, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  run.sh: harness
  eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
instructions: |
  As the terminal story, run the supplied harness in full and require success. This story depends on every implementation story.

=== END ARTIFACT ===
